info.name: Trading Economics Economic Calendar Indicators API
Latest indicator values for one or more countries.

params.name: group
params.description: Filter results to a category group (e.g. `gdp`).

params.name: f
params.description: Output format. JSON is the default for most endpoints.

items.docs: Returns a snapshot of the latest values for all economic indicators for the given country (or comma-separated countries), including interest rates, inflation, GDP, and unemployment. Optionally filter to a category group such as `gdp` with the `group` parameter.

info.name: Latest values of one indicator across all countries.

params.name: f
params.description: Output format. JSON is the default for most endpoints.

items.docs: Returns the latest value of a single indicator - such as `interest rate`, `inflation rate`, or `gdp` - for every country covered, supporting cross-country comparison of macroeconomic series.
